what: The mathematician's window q4 (corpus/riemann/mathematician.md §7): the exact minimiser of κ₉ over even windows of degree 4 — a Rayleigh quotient cᵀMc/(bᵀc)², minimised at c ∝ M⁻¹b in exact rational arithmetic by tools/xi_window.py — rounded to coefficients in (1/10000)·ℤ: v(s) = 1 − (179/625)s² − (10243/2500)s⁴, i.e. 1 − 0.0716(2s)² − 0.25607(2s)⁴ against the paper's 1 − 0.07(2s)² − 0.255(2s)⁴. Same definitions and keys as xi-certificate.json (nine terms of D₁, the tail ε₉, J over the autocorrelation coefficients b_l, κ₉ = (∫v² + J)/(∫v)²); every number re-derived with exact fractions, 2026-10-22.
windowNote: the coefficients of v(s) in powers of s (degree 4, even), on [−1/2, 1/2]
vConvNote: the coefficients b_0..b_n of (v ⋆ v)(r) = ∫_{-1/2}^{1/2-r} v(t) v(t+r) dt for 0 ≤ r ≤ 1, by exact polynomial arithmetic; b_0 = ∫v² and Σ b_l = (v ⋆ v)(1) = 0
